text:
josh: Quick check — thinking of unifying offload decision (evict vs migrate) into allocator metadata instead of the placement manager. Idea: allocator emits an OffloadHint per span and PMGR just follows it. That lets small allocations prefer lazy-migrate and big contiguous spans prefer compaction. Thoughts?
anya: I like the ergonomics. main worry is surface area: allocator now needs policy inputs (hotness, tenant budget). we should avoid exploding the allocator API.
kevin: If allocator takes policy inputs we must version the hint format. runtime will have mixed producers for a while. also migrations are heavy on the PCIe path — prefer reversible hints. :thinking:
sam: perf note from local sims — lazy migrate reduced average token-cost by 8% but made p99 worse by ~12% under bursty workloads. we need telemetry to catch that.
josh: experiment logs: http://ci/redwood/exp/3743 — includes microbench and trace.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: offload-hint-v1 -> 20% @ 2025-11-03T22:00Z
anya: API sketch (proto-ish):

```
struct OffloadHint {
  enum Action {EVICT, LAZY_MIGRATE, PREFETCH}
  Action action;
  uint16_t hotness; // 0..65535
  uint32_t ttl_ms;
  uint8_t version;
}
```

kevin: That seems fine. required telemetry: bytes_moved, fallback_count, p99_delta, tenant_id. We also need a safe default when hint missing.
sam: +1 on tenant_id. cross-tenant fairness was the main regression in the earlier prototype.
josh: rollout plan: feature-flagged, collect metrics for 48h, if error_rate < 0.2% and p99_delta < 5% promote. will also gate on bytes_moved per-minute thresholds.
anya: compaction vs eviction tradeoff: compaction is CPU-bound and can cause stalls if sync. prefer async compaction with soft-exclusive lock; eviction should be immediate but cheaper to undo.
kevin: implementation detail: avoid changing existing page metadata layout. prefer a side-table keyed by span id for OffloadHint to keep on-disk/ABI stable.
sam: one more: add an opt-in debug flag to force ACTION=EVICT for a tenant, so we can A/B test fairness and cost.
josh: good call. I'll draft an RFC with the sketch + telemetry + rollout plan and post to eng-runtime docs tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
